description:
S02 E12 — Bindi Says Yes!
As Bindi celebrates her 21st birthday, she gets a surprise proposal from her boyfriend, Chandler; things get dangerous as Robert wrangles gators in thick mud; Terri helps with the momentous birth of a baby white rhino.

description:
S02 E10 — Turtles Take Flight
Robert and Terri take to the skies to release three rescued sea turtles near the Great Barrier Reef; Bindi anxiously awaits the birth of the zoo's first tiger cub in years; Richie helps a baby wallaby in his struggle for survival.

title: Animal Cribs
description:
S01 E02 — A Backyard to Drool For
The team transforms a hazardous backyard into a dog-friendly escape; a bathroom transforms into a dog wash and feeding station.

title: Animal Cribs
description:
S01 E05 — Football Pup Palace
A wildlife control officer works with dogs with messy habits; Antonio helps turn a laundry room into a doggy spa and a yard into a football-themed paradise.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S08 E02 — Stag Poaching
Texas Game Warden Gould responds to the call about an exotic red stag that was shot; in Hunt County, many warrants are dispersed for unpaid fishing violations; Warden Flores and Warden Williams join forces on the last day on patrol.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S07 E04 — Sparks Flying
During the holiday weekend a jet skier is reported missing, while another is caught without a life vest; warden Kiel witnesses a fist fight during the fireworks, and warden Cummings handles underage drinkers.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S08 E01 — Wild Call
A 12-foot gator manages to trap itself in wires, and the wardens are determined to set it free; Warden Boone responds to a domestic dispute call; a gray fox is found trapped in a residential area; a darted goose chase ensues.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S08 E13 — Passing the Torch
As Warden Richards reminisces on his career during the last day on the job, he races to rescue a cow being attacked by a pack of hunting dogs; at the academy, new recruits wrangle a gator, while anglers are caught illegally fishing.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S07 E06 — Liars and Trespassers
Game Warden McGee rushes to a domestic altercation; Zuniga and Roel run into trespassers; Provasnik inspects a potentially stolen jet ski; Richards and McGee team up on an investigation, and a baby squirrel is rescued.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S08 E03 — Confronting the Captain
In Texas, multiple boats are caught over-harvesting oysters, and the wardens must handle an unruly captain; when a fox is found dead on private property, an investigation begins to find the one responsible.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S06 E06 — Calm After the Storm
Eddins helps a neighbor in need; Reneau responds to a call about a baby red-tailed hawk; Richards attempts to serve an arrest warrant; Startz patrols solo on the Guadalupe River; wardens monitor the Rio Grande.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E02 — Road Killer
In Jackson Parish, a reckless hunter is investigated for shooting down a highway; agents stake out a man suspected of two illegal deer kills; duck hunters are confronted for harassment; a crowded boat parade ends with citations.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E01 — Monster Crabber
Deep in the woods and bayous of Louisiana, wildlife agents protect the state's resources; a crab fisherman is caught stealing dozens of traps, a hunter crosses state lines with an illegal deer and agents rescue an injured bald eagle.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S01 E04 — Spy in the Sky
While using the LDWF's spy in the sky drone, agents track down a boat captain breaking the law in Plaquemines Parish; a family of shrimpers is investigated for pulling oversized nets; two feuding fishermen are suspected of being under the influence.

title: Louisiana Lockdown
description:
S01 E08 — After Midnight
The convicts prepare for the final rodeo of the season; inmate James learns that he has been granted early release from Angola.

title: Louisiana Lockdown
description:

A new inmate to Angola finally meets his grandfather, a prisoner also serving a life sentence; Lt. Col. Slater reconnects with a dying inmate.

title: Louisiana Lockdown
description:
S01 E03 — Drug Bust
An inmate prepares for a reunion with the son he hasn't seen in a decade; teams are put on alert when narcotics infiltrate the penitentiary.

title: Louisiana Lockdown
description:

Warden Cain unleashes the hounds when a prisoner attempts a nighttime escape; inmate Jesse wants to handle more responsibility; inmate Oliver asks permission for a wedding ceremony in Angola.

title: Louisiana Lockdown
description:
S01 E04 — Hunger Strike
Lt. Col. Slater is assigned to run a public horse auction; Warden Cain tries to keep order when inmates stage a hunger strike.

title: Louisiana Lockdown
description:

Lt. Col. Slater balances his prison duties with his responsibilities as a single father; former rodeo champ Cracker risks serious injury for another shot at glory; a local newspaper launches a smear campaign against Warden Cain.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E01 — Hello Houston
Dr. Blue, Dr. Ross and Dr. Lavigne's veterinary venture begins with all hands on deck as they deal with everything from risky surgeries to diagnosing chameleons; a car accident brings everything to a screeching halt when a doctor gets seriously hurt.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E07 — No Goats, No Glory
Dr. Blue and Dr. Ross help a goat farmer at his residence while Dr. Lavigne tries to remove an obstruction within a puppy's intestines; Blue and Ross later have a grill master cook-off.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E03 — The Vet Mobile
Dr. Ross acquires a mobile medical unit for community outreach and Dr. Blue's brother gives it the works; Dr. Ross helps an abscessed iguana; Dr. Lavigne gives a paraplegic dachshund new wheels.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S01 E02 — Turnin' Texan
Dr. Ross's check-up with a large pet upon his return proves to be more than he can handle; Dr. Lavigne performs an emergency C-section on Frenchie; Dr. Blue plans a night on the town to get Dr. Ross out of his funk.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S03 E02 — My Cat or My Family
Jackson's expertise is needed when a family is at odds with their cat, Xena, who suddenly became aggressive; a couple rescued a kitten and their cat, Gigi, has gone from sweet and cuddly to dark and dangerous.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S03 E01 — Cat Fight!
Two couples need Jackson's help against their ferocious felines. Olive and Pepper cannot be left alone in fear that it will end up in a bloodbath; Bengal cat Mufasa is high-energy and uses his owner as a personal clawing board.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S03 E03 — Kitty Dearest
Two couples are at their wits end and need Jackson's help to transform their cats. Oscar turns whiny while going back and forth between owners and Riley is destructive leaving his caretakers to delay starting a family.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E06 — Close Encounters
Two strangers are dropped in one of the most dangerous African locations in the dead heat of summer; faced with aggressive hippos and charging elephants, they quickly learn their place but must mark their territory if they want to make it 21 days.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
Honeymoon From Hell
A married couple goes from watching the challenge from their couch in Idaho to taking it on in the perilous Philippine jungle; torrential rain, relentless bugs and deadly boars put their survival skills and their marriage to the ultimate test.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
Don't Cave In
In the relentless Colombian jungle, a mom and National Guard vet teams with a firefighter; violent storms and hypothermic conditions force them to huddle in bat-infested caves; a special bond develops between a survivalist and a wild monkey.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E21 — Feel the Burn
Dropped into Guyana's scorching savannah, two super fans battle the oppressive heat and relentless insect attacks; scorching temperatures lead to severe dehydration and force a desperate fan to risk illness by drinking unsanitary fluids.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E14 — For Better or a Lot Worse
The first "Naked and Afraid" couple faces challenges to themselves and their relationship as they take on the relentless Guyana jungle; they must work together to battle jaguars, anacondas, caiman, and more than two-million species of insects.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E09 — Blood, Sweat and Fears
Two survivalists are back for redemption in the Mexican jungle but torrential downpours, competing survival styles and a machete accident threaten to send them home early again.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
21 Miles, 21 Days
In a lethal African hunting ground, a biker chick and a taxidermist have to stay on the move to survive; the pair must push across 21 miles of savanna to find food and water while avoiding a pride of lions that's tracking them every step of the way.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E10 — Trying to Deal with the Devil
Deep in Mexico's Baja desert lies the scorching wasteland of the Devil's Canyon; a Canadian mountain man teams up with an experienced homesteader to take on the canyon's triple-digit heat, scarce water, and venomous predators.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:

On a family trip to Pattaya, Thailand, Helen Costigan attends an elephant show when one of the massive beasts turns deadly; golf ball recovery specialist Scott Lahodik is diving in a Florida lake when he's attacked by a vicious alligator.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E03 — Backyard Bite
Outside Corpus Christi, Texas, Jeremy Sutcliffe is working in his garden when a rattlesnake bite puts him on the brink of death; while spearfishing in the Bahamas, Kent Bonde is blindsided by a bull shark that tears the calf muscle from his leg.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E06 — Safari Horror
Bob Legasa is hunting in Montana and what he thinks is a bluff charge from a grizzly bear is, in fact, a near-lethal attack; while canoeing in Zimbabwe, Kristen Yaldor is thrown into the water and finds herself in the jaws of a hippopotamus.

title: I Was Prey
description:

description:

A recent fatal incident in the Alaskan wilderness sends Jeremy on a quest for possible suspects that culminates in a showdown with an unexpected, bizarre water beast.

Jeremy Wade fights through tropical storms and dangerous jungles to search for a Fijian killer that has been part of the local folklore for years, but there may be more than one.

Antonio helps a family who opened their home to neighborhood dogs create the ultimate backyard dog park with custom dog houses, a paddling pool for hot summer days, and a slick structure of ramps and tunnels to keep everyone entertained and active.

The Georgia Aquarium sends a team to Cape Town, South Africa, to help rehabilitate and release a group of African penguins into the wild; a dive team installs a shipwreck feature into an exhibit to provide enrichment for their sea turtle.

Two African penguins, Freya and Neo, welcome a young chick, but there's cause for concern when health problems arise; staff work to train a trio of harbor seals to ride the elevator, with the only hiccup being a nervous seal named Floyd.
